BackstoryDef.title: server-room child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up between humming racks where [PAWN_possessive] parents kept a data haven running. The fans were [PAWN_possessive] lullaby, and [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read from error logs.

BackstoryDef.title: street hacker kid
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] cracked vending machines and ticket gates for a gang of older kids. When the code did not work, [PAWN_possessive] fists did.

BackstoryDef.title: braindance subject
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: A studio paid [PAWN_nameDef]'s family to record what a child feels. [PAWN_pronoun] spent years living other people's memories and still is not sure which of [PAWN_possessive] own are real.

BackstoryDef.title: street netrunner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] dove for whoever paid: fixers, gangs, once even a corporation that wanted another corporation hurt. [PAWN_pronoun] knows what black ICE feels like and keeps a gun close for when the net follows [PAWN_objective] home.

BackstoryDef.title: corporate coder
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] wrote ICE for a megacorporation, in a tower with clean air and cleaner rules. [PAWN_pronoun] has never carried anything heavier than a data chip and does not intend to start.

BackstoryDef.title: runaway braindance tester
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] tested raw braindance recordings for a studio, the ones too sharp to sell. One day [PAWN_pronoun] walked out in the middle of a session. The net has not quite let go of [PAWN_objective] since.

BackstoryDef.title: data courier
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] carried data too hot for any network, in [PAWN_possessive] head or in a case chained to [PAWN_possessive] wrist. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to talk past checkpoints and to shoot past the ones that would not listen.

BackstoryDef.title: former fixer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] used to sit between those who need things done and those who do them. [PAWN_pronoun] has left the trade, but the trade has not forgotten [PAWN_objective]: other fixers still pick up when [PAWN_pronoun] calls.

BackstoryDef.title: corporate guard
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] stood between netrunners' bodies and the corporations they robbed: when the ICE could not stop a runner, [PAWN_pronoun] was sent to the pod.
